contract.cohort: Separate unmeasured upstream architecture candidate; no performance or numeric qualification inferred from baseline
contract.source_transform: Exact function AST; remove autotune/profiler decorators only; fixed prespecified launch config
contract.timed_scope: Direct Triton launch only. Packing, allocation, references, metadata and descriptors prepared outside timer. No torch arithmetic inside fn.
contract.fp8_policy: True unscaled float8 storage; no MXFP8/blockscale substitution; FP32 accumulation; requested output storage.
contract.config_selection: A legal member of the upstream tutorial config list chosen before any GPU measurements; not a best-achievable tuning claim.
contract.input_generation: CPU FP32 seed20261020+index, then cast to actual dtype; CPU FP64 reference uses these rounded inputs.
contract.formula: Independent C[g]=A[g]@B[g]; grouped row-count layout reinterpreted as disjoint row views without arithmetic
contract.architecture_evidence: Official08 TMA requires CUDA>=SM90; compatible Blackwell candidate, NOT Blackwell-specific warp-specialized BMM/GroupGEMM
contract.architecture_specificity: TMA-family optimization only; cannot close strict SM100-exclusive coverage claim for BMM/GroupGEMM
contract.metadata: Device pointer arrays int64, GEMM sizes and strides int32 constructed before timing; all metadata reads included in useful bytes
contract.layout_adapter: B[G,K,N] packed B_T[G,N,K] outside timing; A/C group pointers are contiguous disjoint views

workspace.scope: Descriptor scratch traffic and descriptor encoding are not included in useful algorithmic bytes. Device-descriptor candidates may have extra descriptor work; report separately.
